name: Item scaling: a laddered quest reward keeps its entry and scales to the character's level
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native.QuestRewards=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory. Wanted: Hogger 176 is a level 11 quest whose first choice reward is Footman Tunic 6085 (green, item level 13, required level 5). The tunic has an ItemStat.dbc ladder, so the quest names the authored tunic and the rewarded tunic keeps its entry and item level 13 while storing the character's level 30: its ladder row requires level 27 and carries 192 armor. The level follows the character, not the scaling choice, so a level 30 character with scaling off receives the same level-30 tunic while playing the quest at 11. The client caches the quest query response per quest id across characters, so accepting the quest must send this character's own response. Quest-giver dialogs and client rendering are not tested.

steps.label: The scaled character plays Wanted: Hogger at 26, four below 30 on its curve
The quest query names the authored tunic
The reward is the authored tunic
The tunic stores the character's level 30
The tunic requires level 27 from its ladder row
The tunic carries the ladder row's 192 armor
The unscaled character plays Wanted: Hogger at 11
Accepting the quest tells the unscaled client its own reward, replacing a scaled character's cached copy
The unscaled reward is the authored tunic
The unscaled tunic also stores the character's level 30
The unscaled tunic keeps item level 13
